description: Generic read of a DataService masked struct (MyAvatar, Lot, AdmitInfo_Lot, Messaging_Icon_Avatar, etc.). This is the wire mechanism behind most read-only UI panels; the bot uses it to refresh its local cache on demand.
call_signatures: cf $CF data-service-request   # SCAFFOLD op — not yet implemented; handler may return ok:false or a stub. Prefer a concrete sibling op if your goal is actionable.
common_mistakes: This is a SCAFFOLD op — the convention is declared but the handler may be unimplemented or stubbed. Check the declaration's status field.
Relying on scaffold ops mid-run will either return a deferred marker or fail — prefer a concrete sibling op, and file an rd item if the missing behaviour blocks progress.
perception_hints: These ops return the same shape as the corresponding perception slice; use for fresh mid-turn snapshots
Perception already pushes this data at FSO_PERCEPTION_HZ — only call when you need data newer than the last tick
